Custom Folding Bikes - The Rodriguez 6-Pack™
Travel Bike Image Galleries
"I love my 6-pack" - Rohn G.
Rodriguez 6-Pack™ - Think Small!!
Now you don't have to sacrifice a great ride for small, convenient packing. I could tell you more, but take it from a guy who's owned many other brands first: "If you want a micro-travel bike that rides as well as your full-sized touring bike, there's really only one way to go." Steve C. 6-Pack™ owner and micro-travel bike enthusiast.
• Pack small and save travel hassle
• Your micro-bike can be your only bike
• Completely Custom - It's just your size!
• Hand crafted in Seattle for your unique needs
• Built to ISO standards - Serviceable anywhere
• Anything else.... Just ask!
Full bike from $8,800

The Rodriguez 6-Pack™ uses 6 S&S couplings to make this bike fit into a suitcase as small as 20" X 20", or just about any standard sized suitcase in minutes. The packing ability, ease of break down and re-assembly were all crucial to this bike's design. Every braze-on, component, and unique feature on the bike were chosen for a quick and easy pack/un-pack job for the smallest suitcase possible.
The customer quoted in the first paragraph has owned several micro-folding bikes from various manufacturers, as well as a couple of full-sized touring bikes. Until he rode his new 6-Pack™, he'd never ridden a micro-folder that he thought rode as well as his full-sized bikes. He travels several times per year, and rides thousands of miles on his bikes. He loves his new Rodriguez 6-Pack™. You can read his story here.
He has since sold his full sized touring bike, and purchased a second 6-Pack™
The Rodriguez 6-Pack™ comes in just one size: Your Size. The 6-Pack™ is custom sized and built to order for each rider. We can design the fit around your favorite touring bike, or start from scratch with our NEXT-fit™ system to ensure comfort. All of the component packages (listed below) include our famous handbuilt wheels with a 2-year warranty.
Our bikes are unique as our customers... they love our bikes, and we love them!
